_comment: Workflows per workspace. `category` must match a slug in categories.json — seed categories first or publishing 400s. Both workspaces run the SAME five default workflows (welcome-diner, order-confirmed, order-ready, order-receipt, sign-in-alert) — every customer of the platform is a restaurant chain, so the core set is standard and only the additions differ: Ember & Oak adds order-feedback (a day-after how-was-it), Nolan's adds arriving-soon (delivery nudge). Note order-receipt and order-feedback both trigger on ORDER_COMPLETED — one event, two journeys. Promotional sends are NOT workflows — they go out as a broadcast to the all-subscribers list (see lib/server/hub.ts), which is why `offers` has no workflow here. `welcome-diner` uses the List entry trigger on all-subscribers: joining that list is the signup moment, and it is deliberately not the same thing as broadcasting to the list — the trigger runs once per user as they join, a broadcast sends one template to everyone at once.

workvibe-emberoak.name: Welcome Diner
workvibe-emberoak.description: Welcomes a diner when they join the all-subscribers list — SuprSend emits $USER_ENTERED_LIST once the list has track_user_entry on, so joining the list IS the signup moment. One run per person joining, unlike a broadcast to the same list, which sends once to everyone. Its template templates on $recipient and $brand only: SuprSend emits this event, not the app, so there is no payload to carry custom variables.

workvibe-emberoak.name: Order Confirmed
workvibe-emberoak.description: Confirms the order the moment it lands.

workvibe-emberoak.name: Order Ready
workvibe-emberoak.description: Tells the diner their order is ready — the template's payload says where to collect it or that it is on its way.

workvibe-emberoak.name: Order Receipt
workvibe-emberoak.description: Sends the receipt once the order is paid.

workvibe-emberoak.name: Sign-in Alert
workvibe-emberoak.description: Security notice on a new device sign-in. Can't be unsubscribed from.

workvibe-emberoak.name: Order Feedback
workvibe-emberoak.description: Ember & Oak's addition: a day after an order completes, asks how it went. Triggers on the same ORDER_COMPLETED event as order-receipt — the receipt goes now, this waits a day. Its template needs no payload variables, so the shared event's data doesn't have to carry any.
